The smoke test failed: it exited with code 1 before posting anything to the sandbox.

```
error: LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN is not set. Sandbox tokens expire after 7 days; mint a new one with `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and export it.
```

`LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN` isn't set in this shell. I didn't mint a new token myself, because that creates a credential on an external system. You can either:

- run `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` yourself, `export LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN=...`, and I'll rerun the script, or
- tell me to mint it here and I'll do that and rerun.

As it stands, the script only prints "posting a test invoice to the ledger sandbox" and exits 0. It doesn't actually call the sandbox, so even a passing run won't confirm that the sandbox works.
